instruction:
Library Sheet Set from Existing Model

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey entity and exactly 6 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 4 IfcWall entities, at least 1 IfcSlab entity, and at least 1 IfcRoof entity.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: LOBBY, READING, STACKS, OFFICE, WC, STORE.
7. Every listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [19.0, 9.0, 3.4].
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf has exactly 3 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A001, A101, A201, LIBRARY SHEET SET FROM EXISTING MODEL, LOBBY, READING, STACKS, OFFICE.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
